Surge by Peak XV FAQs | Funding, Eligibility, Applications & Evaluation Startups How we partner People Resources Apply FAQs About Surge What is Surge? Surge is how Peak XV backs founders from day zero. We started Surge in 2019 with a simple goal: help early-stage founders build strong foundations for an enduring company. Since then, we've partnered with 400+ founders building in diverse sectors across the globe, from first check through their scale. Alongside capital, you get hands-on support from the Surge team across hiring, GTM, product, fundraising and more - with operators who've seen the playbook and are in your corner to run it with you. Once a year, we also bring the cohort together for an 8-week Immersion - time with the world's most iconic founders and operators, focused sector tracks, and a founder community that sticks around for life. How much funding will my startup receive? Surge invests up to $5 million in seed capital in each company through an equity investment. Our investments range from $500-$5M. How will the Surge team and community help me build my company? Founders will work with Surge team members, mentors, and experts to make tangible progress towards launching or accelerating their companies. Surge 12 | Building the next era of AI, deeptech, consumer and fintech Startups How we partner People Resources Apply ← Back Surge 12 Building the next era of AI, deeptech, consumer and fintech Social media copy AUTHOR Surge Team We’re excited to welcome 18 new companies to Surge 12 , building across AI, robotics, space, consumer, healthcare, music and fintech. Every Surge cohort gives us a window into what ambitious early-stage founders are choosing to build right now. With Surge 12, three shifts stood out to us. Familiar consumer behaviours are being rebuilt around new expectations. AI is moving from a feature to the underlying architecture of products. And technology is increasingly leaving the screen to tackle physical infrastructure and the real world. Across all three, there’s a common instinct: start from first principles. Our Surge founders are asking whether the products and systems we’ve grown accustomed to should work the way they do at all, and what they might look like if they were being built from scratch today. Rebuilding familiar behaviours Some of the companies in Surge 12 are taking experiences we already know well and rethinking how they should work. August AI is building autonomous clinical intelligence for primary care, combining AI with physician-led care. The company has already grown to nine million users across 160 countries. Ditto is moving dating

Surge 11 Startups How we partner People Resources Apply ← Back Surge 11 Reimagining the Future with Peak XV Social media copy AUTHOR Surge Team With Surge, we’ve always aspired to support outlier founders in building the future they see. That journey continues with Surge 11, our newest cohort. On September 25, founders from 23 startups came together in Mumbai to kick off the program This group of ambitious doers and dreamers showcases a remarkable range of sectors: 12 AI startups across consumer, enterprise, and vertical markets; four fintech innovators; four consumer brands; and three infrastructure and developer tools companies. What unites these founders is grit, the courage to tackle tough challenges, and a first-principles mindset. Surge 11 is also special for its eclectic mix, including many second-time founders, a legendary cricketer, and an Olympic swimming medallist. Together, this cohort is reinventing what’s next for consumers, developers, and enterprises across India, APAC, and global markets. Our three-day kickoff included Fireside Chats where leaders like Amrish Rau, Ronnie Screwvala, Adwaita Nayar, and Dheeraj Pandey spoke about what it takes to build an enduring company. Surge founders also heard from legends Sachin Tendulkar and Usain Bolt about the great rewards that come from resilience and discipline. The event brought together founders from past cohorts
